title: DIY Crafts Copper Wire Brushes, Wire Brush Wheel, Copper Wire Polishing Wheel Kits for Dremel Rotary Tools (1/8 Inch Shank) (6)
description: 【WHAT YOU GET】- In this Stainless Steel Wheel Brushes kit, you will get polishing brushes, including 3 shapes. Comes with T Shape wire brushes, Bowl Shape wire brushes and Pen Shape wire brushes. Different shapes meet different needs. 【COPPER WIRE MATERIAL】- Our Copper Wire Brushes are made of premium steel, not easy to shed, and wear-resistant. Steel is hard, good to use in steel and aluminum surface, very nice in sanding metal surface. Improving the quality of products by stripping residue, burring, grinding, polishing. 【WIDE RANGE OF APPLICATIONS】- Our wire polishing wheel brushes can make your polished goods look clean and bright. It widely used for various surface buffing and cleaning, such as polishing of metal, wood, glass, stainless steel, tableware, precision instrument, marble, etc. 【WHEEL BRUSH SIZE】 - Stainless steel wheel T shape brush diameter is 25mm/1 inch, Shank is 35mm/ 1.4 inch. Bowl shape is 15mm/0.5inch, Shank is 35mm/ 1.4 Inch; Pen shape is 0.8mm/0.3inch. Mandrel Polishing Wheels fits Dremel polishing kit, polishers, hand drill etc. 【WARM PROMPT】- Fit your hand drill, drill press, Dremel rotary tool with a 1/8" Collet. Control the speed of your rotary tool, do not run in excess of 10000 RPM. Before you use the wire brushes sets, please make sure you wear safety glasses and Protective equipment!
